fields.summary: Planned the Fix for Claude Code sessions stalling at the folder-trust prompt in a new repo. The owner picked the agent's recommended options throughout. The Fix serves m24-on-the-vm. The trust write goes in a new optional adapter interface that claudecode implements. session run calls it before every agent start and skips it on --dry-run, so Adapter.Command stays pure. It marks the main checkout root and the session's working dir as trusted (hasTrustDialogAccepted=true) in ~/.claude.json, or in $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/.claude.json when that is set. The write keeps every other key and is atomic (temp file and rename). It never overwrites a malformed file. When the file can't be read or written, the session starts anyway and the failure is reported as a warning.
fields.title: Planning the folder-trust fix, with the owner
